name: toolshop-api-tests
description: Postman collection and Newman runs for the Practice Software Testing Toolshop API

scripts.test: newman run collections/toolshop.postman_collection.json -e environments/toolshop.postman_environment.json --timeout-request 20000 --delay-request 300 --folder "00 Warm-up" --folder "01 Catalogue (no login)" --folder "02 Login and tokens" --folder "03 Account lifecycle" --folder "04 Cart and checkout" --folder "05 Access control" --folder "06 Known issues" -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/index.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Toolshop API tests"
scripts.test:data: newman run collections/toolshop.postman_collection.json -e environments/toolshop.postman_environment.json --timeout-request 20000 --delay-request 300 --folder "07 Search terms (data-driven)" -d data/search-terms.csv -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/data-driven.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Toolshop: search terms (data-driven)"

author: Afzal Ahmed
